bug_info.bug_desc: In the pre-merge RTL, the valid_q register is asynchronously reset, but the key_q storage register is not reset at all. Per the spec, reset must clear all stored key data to zero. Because key_q has no reset assignment, it retains an arbitrary/unknown value after reset or power-up, and this value is continuously presented on key_o, which can expose unknown key data to downstream logic.
bug_info.fix_hint: Add reset handling to the key_q register so that when rst_ni is deasserted, all shares of key_q are cleared to zero. This reset must take precedence over the existing clr_i and set_i update paths, and the existing clear/set behavior should be preserved once reset is released.
